quest.title: A Visitor From Westward Realms
quest.description: A person from Sumeru has arrived at the wharfs of Liyue Harbor. She seems to be in a bit of a fix...

talks.objective: Go to the wharf at Liyue Harbor

dialogues.speaker: Nazafarin
dialogues.text: Oh, by Lesser Lord Kusanali, I have indeed met with disaster!

dialogues.speaker: Nazafarin
dialogues.text: Kusanali be blessed. Are you two the great heroes who have come to rescue poor Nazafarin?

dialogues.speaker: Nazafarin
dialogues.text: Ah, this is indeed what they call... Uh, what do they call it again? "A blanket on a cold day?" "A gift of charcoal in the rain?"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um, are those things that people from Sumeru say, or what?

choices.text: I suspect that those are things only she says...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's true. Also, pretty sure rain's not a good time for charcoal. "A gift of charcoal in the snow," maybe?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Yes, that's right. Indeed, you are a gift of charcoal amidst the snow.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, never mind that for now. So, you're called Nazafarin, right? Well, then, Nazafarin, what can we do to help you?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Ah, what a bright one you are, and to the point, too! In truth, I, Nazafarin, am facing the greatest crisis of my existence, O great heroes!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Just Paimon will do, thanks! And this is {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #Yes, I'm {NICKNAME}, at your service.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: And what a pleasure it is to meet you both! I'm Nazafarin!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's fine, you've mentioned your name before... Anyway, what trouble are you in?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: So here's what happened: I have a very ambitious friend named Parvaneh. She once told me that she would manufacture a seasoning that would bring happiness to all people.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh? How's a seasoning supposed to do that?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Um, Nazafarin isn't sure either.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Still, Parvaneh said that this seasoning would make any dish especially delicious!

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: I am certain that happiness may be found through especially delicious food.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! So that's how it would work!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You didn't take much convincing.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: She went on a trip overseas just so she might be able to create that seasoning...

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: But she has been incredibly busy with work, what with her traveling and doing research at the same time. And I, her friend, could do little from the sidelines in Sumeru...

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: So I decided that I must help her somehow! I've given the matter some thought based on the direction of the conversations we had beforehand. I was so grieved that I did not eat or drink...

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: After "grieving to the point of neither eating nor drinking," I finally realized what it was that I could do!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, "grieved" might not be the right word to use here.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Ah, yes, thank you for the reminder. Liyue's aphorisms really are hard to use. I need to study them more.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, let's get back on topic. What did you think of?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Ah, yes! So I came up with an idea.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Essentially, I could follow Parvaneh's train of thought to create some seasoning recipes before adding them to dishes and asking people what they think of them.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: I mean to help Parvaneh conduct a market study and send her the data that we obtain from it.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: As you know, practical studies are a very important aspect of doing research. This is as much as I can do for my most busy friend.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: While I don't think that the seasoning recipes that I've come up with are what she's looking for, necessarily...

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: I believe that the feedback that people will give regarding these seasonings shall help Parvaneh to create the seasoning of her dreams!

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: That's why I've come to Liyue, famous as it is for gourmet food! It is said that the people here truly love food. I'm sure they'll give me just the inspiration I need!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, uh, have you figured out what seasonings you wanna use yet? Or do you need us to help with that, too?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: No, no. Blessed Kusanali above, don't you worry. Leave the pondering about the recipe to me, the one from Sumeru.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: We are most adept at seasoning our food. In fact, I have already come up with something in the time we were talking.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: So, yes, thank you so much! You two are indeed the great saviors of poor Nazafarin, yes, indeed!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, sure? You're welcome?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So what do you need our help with, actually?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: In truth... though I, Nazafarin, have indeed thought of the seasoning, I know not a soul here in Liyue.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Nor am I some manner of professional adventurer who can gather my own ingredients. It shall be too difficult — oh yes, as difficult as it would be for a rookie wet behind the ears to enter the Eremites' headquarters by themselves...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Who are the Eremites?

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: They are an organization of warriors-for-hire in Sumeru. They are true soldiers of fortune who will do anything for money. There are some among them who even use bizarre yet formidable powers.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: I shudder even to think about it... Let us amble back to our previous topic, please.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: #Now then, Nazafarin would like the good Paimon and {NICKNAME} to help gather ingredients according to the recipes and create said seasonings!

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Then we shall add them to food, bring said dishes before people you know, and record their feedback for later perusal.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, Paimon gets it! C'mon, you could have just said so. Alrighty then, we've got your back, easy! We know tons of people!

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Ah, Kusanali be praised! Bless both your good hearts! I will continue to dream up recipes in the meantime, and shall tell you once I have finalized them.

response.speaker: Nazafarin
response.text: Please, take this pot that I had specially made by an artisan in Sumeru. I am certain that the seasonings we make shall bring happiness to all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Woohoo! Let's go, {NICKNAME}! Paimon volunteers as taste tester number one, by the way!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, that certainly explains your enthusiasm...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehehe... Come on, come on! Let's get a move on!

choices.text: Nobody from Sumeru we've met before has said anything remotely like that...

talks.objective: Talk to the clearly flustered person
